俺達は未調査<r=ドリフト>横坑</r>の探索を進めていた。: We were continuing our exploration of the unmapped Drift.
油断が招いた不意打ちを経験したおかげか、\nチーム全体に気の抜けた様子は見られな: Perhaps thanks to experiencing that surprise attack caused by carelessness, there was no sign of anyone in the team slacking off.
だが、いつ敵が現れるかわからない緊張感と同時に、\n未調査領域を探索する冒険心も: However, along with the tension of not knowing when an enemy might appear, there was also a sense of adventure in exploring uncharted territory.
はい、メイズシフターの痕跡も全然ありません……: Yes, there are no traces of Maze Shifters at all...
痕跡がなくともどこに潜んでいるかわからないので、\n警戒は怠らないでくださいね。: Even if there are no traces, we don't know where they might be hiding, so please stay vigilant.
わかってる。今度はもう、油断しない。: I know. I won't drop my guard this time.
う～っ……くるならこい！\nやっつけてやるぅ！: Ugh... Come at us if you dare! I'll take you all down!
いや、呼ばなくていいから。\n何事もないに越したことないし。: No, please don't invite them. It's better if nothing happens at all.
だが、それにしても順調すぎる……: Still, things are going almost too smoothly...
見えない脅威を警戒し続け、\n俺達の精神は少しづつ削られていく。: Constantly staying on guard against an invisible threat was slowly wearing down our mental state.
時々、通信機から息遣いの音が聞こえる。: Occasionally, the sound of breathing could be heard over the comms.
俺も大きく息を吸い込み、\nゆっくりと深呼吸をした。: I also took a deep breath in and exhaled slowly.
前方、敵影なし……まだ進めます……: Ahead, no enemy readings... We can still keep going...
後方も安全確保。……まだ大丈夫。: Rear is secure too... Still fine.
みんなの声にも覇気がない。\n消耗が激しいのだろう……: There was no energy in anyone's voice. The strain must be taking a heavy toll...
敵と遭遇したら帰還する。そう考えているうちに、\nだいぶ奥まで進んでいたようだ。: We had planned to head back as soon as we encountered an enemy, but while keeping that in mind, we seemed to have pushed quite far inside.
ドリフトの中は、依然として不自然な静寂に包まれている。: An unnatural silence still hung over the inside of the drift.
……あの、改めてさっきのフォローありがとう。気が緩んでた。: ...Um, thanks again for covering for me earlier. I had let my guard down.
ん？ ああ、さっきのメイズシフターの件か。: Hmm? Ah, about that Maze Shifter earlier.
本当に油断してた。ラミも助かったよ。: I really was being careless. Rami was saved thanks to you too.
あのさ……正直に答えてほしいんだけど……\nラミのこと生意気なヤツだって思ってる: Hey... I want you to answer honestly... You think Rami's a cocky brat, don't you?
（どうしたんだ、いきなり……）: (What's gotten into her all of a sudden...?)
ラミさ、こんなちんちくりんな見た目だから、\n入学した当時はすっごく周りからナメ: You see, with Rami looking like such a short squirt, people looked down on me so much when I first enrolled.
前からナメられるのだけは我慢ならなくて、憎まれ口をきいて、\n自分を大きく見せな: I couldn't stand being looked down on, so I mouthed off and acted tough... I couldn't protect myself unless I made myself seem bigger...
（ラミってこんな簡単に、弱みを見せるような子だったか？）: (Was Rami always the type to show her weaknesses so easily?)
――わたしも、みんなから『できるヤツ』だと思われてるけど、\n本当は全然そんなこ: —I'm the same. Everyone thinks I'm 'capable,' but truth is, I'm really not like that at all.
むしろ、その逆。ポンコツっていうか……\nただいつもなぜか妙に運が良くて、なんで: In fact, it's the exact opposite. I'm more like a klutzy mess... It's just that for some reason I'm strangely lucky, so everything always turns out fine.
どうしたんだ、お前ら。今までそんな話しようともしなかったのに。: What's wrong with you two? You've never even tried talking about stuff like this before.
……なんでだろう。ラミもわかんない。こんな話、誰にも\nするつもりなかったのに…: ...I wonder why. Rami doesn't get it either. I never intended to tell anyone about this... What is this? I can't even gather my thoughts...
（もしかして、俺やみんなの消耗の激しさも……）: (Could the extreme exhaustion everyone and I are feeling also be...)
これも『メイズシンドローム』の症状か！？: Is this a symptom of 'Maze Syndrome' too!?
すまない、七彩ッ！ 引き返すぞ！ メイズシンドロームだ！！: I'm sorry, Nanairo! We're turning back! It's Maze Syndrome!!
（くそ、思考力が落ちていて、判断が遅れた……！）: (Damn it, my thinking was dulled, so my reaction was delayed...!)
瞬間、周囲から地響きが聞こえてきた。: Instantly, a rumble echoed through the surroundings.
っ、ぜ、前方に敵影……！ メイズシフターですっ！: Ngh, e-enemy reading ahead...! It's a Maze Shifter!
くっ……頭が働かないこんなときに……！: Guh... Of all the times for my brain to go fuzzy...!
っ……迎え撃ちますわ！\n陣形を整え、攻撃準備！: Ngh... We will intercept! Form up and prepare to attack!
明らかに全員、本調子ではない。\nだが、もはや俺達に選択の余地はなかった。: Everyone was clearly far from their best condition. However, we no longer had any choice.
